output.scope_note: The paper is a structure-resolved simulation study of composite cathodes for all-solid-state batteries, and it reports one Li-ion bulk conductivity for the argyrodite Li6PS5Cl as a model input taken from the literature; the other conductivities are normalized values or liquid electrolyte values.
